findings.issue: One conjunction is rendered as both cause and condition.
Two prepositions plus a 3ms suffix (from + after + him) are reduced to location behind him; the ablative preposition is omitted.
Qal imperfect 2mp with paragogic nun is not middle or reflexive; se is unmarked voice smoothing.

notes: Ustedes forms on the 2mp verbs keep the addressees; añadirá and dejarlo match the 3ms weqatal and the hiphil infinitive with its 3ms suffix.
